scientific_limitations: Applies to three-layer finite incidence Kripke frames induced by hypergraphs uniform of edge size one, two, or three, not arbitrary finite frames.
Does not prove any separation between complexity classes L and coNP.
Explicit lower reductions and the semantic correspondence are proved; standard undirected-connectivity and monotone NAE-3SAT complexity theorems are used as cited external inputs.
Finite exhaustive cases confirm the semantic equivalence but do not prove asymptotic hardness; independent audit is not performed.
title: The three-rank complexity spectrum of McKinsey validity on incidence frames
